title: Kairos Hermes 2 unit 2: Kairos Power LLC, Emails Regarding Request for Regulatory Guide 5.81, Revision 2 [['E-Mail']]

documents.text:
From:             Edward Helvenston
To:               "Margaret Ellenson"
Cc:               ext_Drew_Peebles; ext_Leah_Parks; Michael Orenak; Cayetano Santos; Kara Smith
Subject:          RE: Request a copy of RG 5.81
Date:             Thursday, November 5, 2026 8:29:00 AM
Attachments:      image001.png
                  image002.png



Hello Margaret,

This e-mail is in response to Kairos’ request, by e-mail below dated November 3, 2026,
regarding access to a certain non-public document relating to nuclear reactor security. Upon
review of the request, the NRC staff has established that Kairos does have the need-to-know
for this document. Therefore, the following document is being made available to Kairos:

         Regulatory Guide 5.81, Revision 2, “Target Set Identification and Development for
         Nuclear Power Reactors,” dated March 2026

The document has been uploaded to the shared SharePoint folder titled “Security.” Please
contact Kairos’ NRC Project Managers with any questions regarding access to this document.
Note that this document is marked as Official Use Only – Security Related Information and as
such it is Kairos’ responsibility to control access to this document. Kairos should ensure that
only those with the need-to-know will gain access to the document.

Thank you,
Ed


Ed Helvenston, U.S. NRC
Advanced Reactor Licensing Branch 4 (ARLB4)
Division of Advanced Reactor Licensing (DARL)
Office of Advanced Reactors (OAR)
(301) 415-4067



From: Margaret Ellenson <ellenson@kairospower.com>
Sent: Tuesday, November 3, 2026 3:24 PM
To: Edward Helvenston <Edward.Helvenston@nrc.gov>
Cc: ext_Drew_Peebles <peebles@kairospower.com>; ext_Leah_Parks <parks@kairospower.com>
Subject: [External_Sender] Request a copy of RG 5.81

Hi Ed,

May I please have a copy of Regulatory Guide 5.81, “Target Set Identification and Development
for Nuclear Power Plants,” Revision 2?
 I understand the guide is OUO-SRI and must be requested. Kairos Power would like a copy to
inform the security analysis for the Hermes 2 facility.

Thank you,
Margaret




                     Margaret Ellenson   Safeguards and Security Manager

                     p (510) 775-1861 email: ellenson@kairospower.com
                     she, her, hers           
                     707 W Tower Ave, Alameda, CA 94501
